einzeiler: Survivor Amber Keel shares how anti-trafficking founder Candace Leard defrauded donors.
kurzfassung: Amber Keel survived a severe background of addiction and sex trafficking before dedicating herself to helping other survivors in Utah. She partnered with high-profile anti-trafficking activist Candace Rivera, founder of the nonprofit Exodus, to build support systems for victims. However, investigations later revealed that Candace was operating a massive fraud, embezzling hundreds of thousands of dollars and fabricating her credentials.
stichpunkte: Amber Keel grew up in Salt Lake City facing family hardships, heavy drug addiction, and subsequent sex trafficking.
After years of abuse and legal battles, Amber got sober and began working as a survivor advocate to help others escape similar fates.
She partnered with Candace Rivera, founder of the anti-trafficking nonprofit Exodus, to establish aftercare services and joint task forces with law enforcement.
Amber eventually joined Exodus full-time and discovered a severe lack of official paperwork, intake records, and operational transparency.
Law officials arrested Candace Rivera on dozens of felony charges, including fraud, theft, and forgery, revealing she embezzled donor funds for personal luxury.
Investigations exposed that Candace lied about being a nurse and fabricated medical credentials while operating international and local rescue initiatives.
Candace was sentenced to three to 15 years in prison, leaving the local anti-trafficking network and trust severely fractured.
Amber continues to share her story to warn the public and ensure accountability ahead of Candace's upcoming parole hearing.

kapitel.titel: Entering the World of Sex Trafficking

clips.text: The speaker recounts forcing entry into a home after getting no response at the entrance.
Amber describes being rushed to an emergency room at high speed in the dark, regaining awareness only after medical staff began intravenous treatment.
A brief promotional spot highlights the podcast Pro Society and its discussions on literature, reading communities, and popular culture.
The episode notes how major athletic gatherings like the NBA All-Star event in Utah typically bring a rise in illicit betting, illegal narcotics, and human exploitation.

clips.hook: Embezzling donor funds for a house
clips.text: The speaker reflects on how seeking solitude led to unexpected friendly encounters and opportunities for personal self-discovery.

beschreibung:
After overcoming extraordinary hardship, Amber dedicated herself to helping other survivors. What begins as a story of healing and purpose takes a shocking turn when the organization she trusts becomes the center of a criminal investigation.
If you would like to share your story, you can reach out to the Betrayal team by emailing us at betrayalpod@gmail.com. You can also find us on Instagram at @betrayalpod and @glasspodcasts.
To access our newsletter and additional content and to connect with the Betrayal community, join our Substack at betrayal.substack.com.
If you are currently in crisis, please reach out to organizations that offer immediate support. We are including a few US-based resources here:
988 Lifeline. If you or someone you know is in crisis or need to talk to someone immediately, please call or text 988 – the National Suicide and Crisis Lifeline available 24/7/365.
National Domestic Violence Hotline. They offer 24/7 phone and chat support to help you create a personalized safety plan and connect you with local support.
For resources on sexual violence, visit rainn.org/betrayal. You can also get free, confidential, 24/7 support through RAINN’s National Sexual Assault Hotline. Text HOPE to 64673 or call 1-800-656-HOPE.
Every state has a domestic violence coalition. If you’re looking for help in the US, search the web for your state’s domestic violence coalition.
